correctness.bounded_reproduction: An independently written exhaustive check enumerated all 3125 transformations at n=5, found 196 idempotents and 3106 permissible pairs, and compared both composites on one input of each of the three classes for all 9647236 ordered pairs. It gave rows (196,2160,1140), (2160,67755,56595), (1140,56595,53925), total 241666. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/f527f762-6c2b-4cea-a001-95122ec54d91/direct_n5_census.py. This checks the finite census within the normal form; the published classification and analytic proof carry the universal assertion.
correctness.rationale: For n≥5 Gould–Grau–Johnson Theorem 2.1 and Lemma 2.5 give the unique (t,e) normal form; Corollary 2.6(4) confirms the product rule in right-action notation. Reversing the composition notation does not affect equality of the two products. For fixed e, te=e=et fixes each root and preserves its fiber; t³=t makes the restriction to its image an involution and leaves the remaining arrows freely attached to image points. This gives the stated A,B,C,D weights, including the product of signs across fibers. The image {t,t²,e} collapses to rank one precisely at t=e and to rank two for other idempotent t; t²=e implies t=t³=te=e. Among even permutations only t=id gives rank two, and all odd parameters have rank three. Equating the two product parameters gives all pairs of even types and all pairs of nonpermutation types with the same e, odd diagonal pairs, and mixed pairs at common e only with the designated even (id,e) or nonpermutation (e,e) element. For the constant identity-valued map b₀, the competing constant values are id and u², so precisely the permutation-parameter elements and b₀ itself commute with it. This gives the stated ordered rank polynomial. Evaluating at x=y=1 gives E²+N²+7O+4E per nonidentity e. The all-singleton fiber adds 5 before replacing it by the single b₀ self-pair, hence −4 exp(z) in the exponential formula. The rank-seven exceptions at n=4 and units are excluded as stated. The frozen script and output were inspected as text, not executed.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Counting ordered loops and twice each undirected edge by rank would recover the analogous invariant on retractions, not on all nonautomorphisms.
